name: Sinotrans Limited
summary: Sinotrans Limited provides integrated logistics services primarily in the People's Republic of China. It operates through three segments: Agency and Related Business, Professional Logistics, and E-commerce. The company offers sea freight, air freight, rail freight, shipping agency, terminals and containers, yards, feeder/barges, logistics information systems, and supply chain security.
